podcast.title: Band Name Changes and Lineup
podcast.body: Joey Armstrong's band initially known as Emily's Army, went through multiple name changes before settling on SWMRS (spelled SWMRS). During its lineup changes, his younger brother, Jacob Armstrong, temporarily played bass. "That group was known as Emily's Army, and they went through a bunch of name changes until 2011...There were some lineup changes, including the temporary appearance of little brother Jacob Armstrong on bass. And then the group changed their name to Swimmers, which is spelled SWMRS."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Inspiration and Band Formation
podcast.body: Joseph Marciano Armstrong, nicknamed Joey after Joey Ramone, was born on February 28th, 1995. He decided to form his own band, Emily's Army, with a friend named Cole after they watched the movie "School of Rock" starring Jack Black. "And on February 28th, 1995, Joseph Marciano Armstrong came into the world. He's called Joey after Joey Ramon. Joey finally decided to form his own band after he and his buddy Cole saw School of Rock with Jack Black for the first time. That group was known as Emily's Army."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Previous Band Name
podcast.body: Emily's Army was the original name for the band that later became known as Swimmers, featuring Joey Armstrong. "their previous name, which was Emily's Army."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Son of Billie Joe Armstrong
podcast.body: Joey Armstrong is the son of Green Day frontman Billie Joe Armstrong. "Swimmers, which features Joey Armstrong, son of Billy Joe of Green Day."

xref.body: Emily's Army was formed by Joey Armstrong and his friend Cole after watching "School of Rock." The band underwent several name changes before becoming SWMRS. Joey's younger brother, Jacob Armstrong, had a temporary stint playing bass for the group. "That group was known as Emily's Army, and they went through a bunch of name changes...There were some lineup changes, including the temporary appearance of little brother Jacob Armstrong on bass. And then the group changed their name to Swimmers, which is spelled SWMRS."

xref.title: Son of Billie Joe Armstrong
xref.body: Jacob Danger Armstrong is the younger brother of Joey Armstrong and the second son of Green Day's Billie Joe Armstrong, following in his father's musical footsteps. "Jacob Danger Armstrong that's Joey's younger brother in Billy Joe's second son."
